name: AmericasNLP 2021 Shared Task: Translation for Indigenous Americas Languages
description: AmericasNLP 2021 Shared Task dataset provides parallel corpora for machine translation between Spanish and 10 indigenous languages of the Americas: Ashaninka, Aymara, Bribri, Guarani, Hnahnu (Otomi), Nahuatl, Quechua, Raramuri (Tarahumara), Shipibo-Konibo, and Wixarika (Huichol). The benchmark provides clean training, development, and evaluation splits to advance natural language processing on extremely low-resource, endangered languages native to North, Central, and South America.
